Nina thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was cloudy that day. Life is full of small surprises. The school's biggest event is Sports Day.
Nina is going to travel to Paris in April. Nina learned a lot about history. Both of them like chicken and tea. The widower bakes every Sunday now.
Nina borrowed a book about history from the museum. Nina and Sam had great fun there. Last Monday, Nina and Sam went to the temple fair. Best of all, she raised us as a single parent.
The temple fair is one of the best places in the city. It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. Nina's favorite animal is the rabbit.
